races.paceDynamic: Kisuton Enki looks the lone confirmed early leader in this 13-runner maiden, with Babyburn likely to track closely given his prominent style. The lack of natural pace-pressers means Kisuton Enki can dictate terms without being harried early, creating a measured tempo that suits patient types. With the majority of the field holding up including Fly Away Home, Meghan Mala, and the Mullins/Townend combinations, this race sets up perfectly for hold-up horses who can unleash late finishing kicks. This tactical scenario strongly favours closers over front-runners.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Sustained Kick Triumph
scenarios.trigger: If the pace stays steady and the field bunches turning for home
scenarios.body: The large pack of hold-up horses gets the perfect setup with Kisuton Enki setting manageable fractions. Class and finishing speed separate the closers, with Fly Away Home's proven RPR 121 and consistent form giving her the edge over fellow back-markers.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Runner Survives
scenarios.trigger: If Kisuton Enki maintains his lead without serious early pressure
scenarios.body: With no sustained pace battle early, Kisuton Enki conserves energy and has enough left to repel the late challengers. His OR 120 rating and Jack Kennedy's tactical nous prove decisive against the largely inexperienced closer brigade.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Mid-Race Injection Changes
scenarios.trigger: If Babyburn or another prominent runner applies unexpected mid-race pressure
scenarios.body: The tempo quickens significantly from the back straight, stretching the field and blunting the finishing kicks of the hold-up brigade. Horses with early pace find themselves better positioned when the real racing begins.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Cavalry Charge Finish
scenarios.trigger: If multiple closers produce simultaneous finishing efforts in the final furlong
scenarios.body: The patient tactics backfire as too many horses hit top gear together, causing traffic problems and interference. The first horse to find clear running or one with superior finishing speed breaks clear from the melee.

Monitor for traffic problems in the home straight as multiple hold-up horses will be seeking racing room simultaneously

Watch Paul Townend's positioning on Babyburn as Mullins horses often improve significantly for stable bookings

races.paceDynamic: Ma Jacks Hill will set the pace as the only confirmed front runner, with Colleen Danu likely providing company from a prominent position early on. The soft ground and 2m5½f trip should produce a sustainable gallop without fierce early pressure, allowing the leaders to control the tempo. The bulk of the field comprises hold-up horses (Crowsatedappletart, Jay Jay Zee, Collaborative, Grange Walk, Way Down South, Miss Corby) who will look to time their challenges from off the pace. This pace scenario strongly favours the hold-up horses who can exploit the controlled early gallop and finish strongly up the hill.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Ma Jacks Hill sets a steady pace without serious pressure through the middle stages
scenarios.body: The sustained gallop plays into the hands of the closers who can unleash finishing kicks on the testing ground. Collaborative and Crowsatedappletart have proven soft ground form and the tactical speed to capitalise.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Runners Excel
scenarios.trigger: If Colleen Danu travels strongly and Ma Jacks Hill maintains forward momentum turning for home
scenarios.body: The two prominent runners avoid the traffic problems that could hamper the hold-up brigade on the narrow Limerick track. Ma Jacks Hill's class edge combines with Colleen Danu's tactical advantage to dominate the finish.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Soft Ground Specialists
scenarios.trigger: If the testing conditions become the decisive factor as the race develops
scenarios.body: Horses with proven soft ground credentials like Way Down South and Jay Jay Zee find extra gear that others cannot match. Their superior handling of the conditions outweighs any tactical disadvantages.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Early
scenarios.trigger: If Ma Jacks Hill goes too slowly early and the field bunches up approaching the home turn
scenarios.body: A sprint finish develops where pure speed trumps stamina, favouring horses that retain their turn of foot despite the conditions. The race becomes a lottery with any horse capable of striking.

The ground conditions deteriorating further as several runners have mixed records on testing surfaces

races.paceDynamic: He Can't Dance will lead from the start with no genuine pace pressure in this small field, creating a moderate tempo that suits his sustainable front-running style. King's Bucks will track prominently behind the leader, while the hold-up horses Loyal Praetorian, Sam's Favourite, Three County Star and Strand Street Lass will be held up in the rear division. With soft ground potentially sapping stamina reserves and He Can't Dance able to dictate terms without pressure, this race shape strongly favours front-runners and prominent racers who can secure good positions early without expending energy.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Leader Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If He Can't Dance gets an easy lead and kicks clear approaching the last
scenarios.body: The lack of early pace allows him to conserve energy before producing his winning move, with the soft ground working in his favour. King's Bucks may chase him home but cannot match the leader's tactical advantage.

scenarios.label: B

scenarios.body: His class advantage tells as he outbattles the leader up the run-in, with Darragh O'Keeffe timing his challenge perfectly. The De Bromhead runner's superior rating proves decisive in the closing stages.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Mullins Wildcard Emerges
scenarios.trigger: If Casual Water shows improved form on seasonal reappearance for Willie Mullins
scenarios.body: The lightly-raced five-year-old benefits from the steady pace to make smooth late progress under Paul Townend. His unknown ability level allows him to surprise more exposed rivals in typical Mullins fashion.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Surprise
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses completely and becomes a sprint finish
scenarios.body: Loyal Praetorian or Three County Star benefit from the tactical mess to produce late rallies. However, their recent form suggests they lack the class to capitalise even in ideal circumstances.

races.paceDynamic: Hardy Stuff emerges as the sole natural front runner in this field, with Sense Of Occasion, Something Noble (non-runner), and Chosen Shant likely to sit prominent behind him. With limited pace pressure and soft ground creating energy-sapping conditions, Hardy Stuff can dictate a measured tempo through the early stages before the pace inevitably quickens approaching the business end. The hold-up horses Arctic Flame, Piccolo Player, Shellrunforbriggs and Market Ready will need to overcome a tactical disadvantage as the sustained pace over 2m on heavy ground typically favours those who travel closer to the tempo. This race shape clearly favours prominent racers and those with tactical pace, as they can position optimally without facing the energy-draining task of making up significant ground late.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hardy Stuff Controls Tempo
scenarios.trigger: If Hardy Stuff gets an uncontested lead and dictates moderate early fractions
scenarios.body: His natural front-running style perfectly suits the tactical scenario, allowing him to quicken when it matters most. The lack of pace pressure plays directly into Gordon Elliott's hands with Jack Kennedy able to time his challenge perfectly.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Rally Succeeds
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace becomes genuinely slow and the hold-up horses get ideal positioning
scenarios.body: Arctic Flame and Shellrunforbriggs can utilise their finishing kicks to full effect when the race develops into a sprint finish. The soft ground won't drain their energy reserves if they're perfectly placed entering the final half-mile.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If Sense Of Occasion or Chosen Shant can track Hardy Stuff and pounce late
scenarios.body: The prominent runners get the best of both worlds - close enough to the pace but with enough in reserve for a telling late surge. Their tactical positioning allows them to respond immediately to any move Hardy Stuff makes.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If Hardy Stuff goes too slow early and multiple horses challenge simultaneously
scenarios.body: The race becomes a messy scramble where positioning and traffic luck determine the outcome more than ability. Market Ready's recent run and tactical speed could prove decisive in a muddling finish.

races.paceDynamic: Only A Dollar provides the sole confirmed front-running presence in this 21-runner field, with Springboard and Uptaurintop likely to race prominently but lacking genuine pace-pressing credentials. This creates a tactical scenario where Only A Dollar can dictate terms without significant early pressure, establishing a controlled rhythm over the 2m trip on testing soft ground. The sustainable pace will allow the large pack of hold-up horses to remain competitive into the straight, but the lack of genuine pace pressure means those who can track the leader without over-racing hold a decisive advantage. This race shape strongly favours prominent racers and forward-positioned horses who can avoid the inevitable traffic problems that 18+ hold-up horses will create in the home straight.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Leader Wins

scenarios.body: Only A Dollar dictates ideal fractions and has enough left to resist late challengers on ground that will blunt finishing kicks. The 207-day break becomes less relevant when controlling the tempo throughout.

scenarios.trigger: If prominent racers secure ideal tracking positions behind the leader
scenarios.body: Horses like Uptaurintop and Springboard avoid the inevitable traffic chaos while staying close enough to challenge. Their forward positioning proves decisive when the hold-up brigade gets shuffled back in the large field.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Hero Emerges
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses completely allowing strong stayers through
scenarios.body: One of the better hold-up horses like Houndsworth or Wild Wild Wind finds clear running and benefits from a truly-run race. The soft ground aids their stamina reserves over the shorter hold-up horses.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Chaos Benefits Outsider
scenarios.trigger: If early fallers or interference creates opportunities for unconsidered runners
scenarios.body: The large field and testing conditions cause carnage that eliminates fancied runners. A horse like Sidiriya or The Toothpicker emerges from the mayhem with a clear passage.

races.paceDynamic: Brother Hollie will take them along at a steady gallop in this competitive handicap hurdle, with only one other prominent runner (Hakensack) for company early on. The soft ground and 2m3½f trip will create a searching test of stamina, with the pace likely to be honest but not breakneck given the lack of natural front-runners. With 16 of the 18 runners employing hold-up tactics, there will be a wall of horses coming off the pace from the back straight onwards. This race shape strongly favours horses with a finishing kick who can travel smoothly through the race and quicken when it matters.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Heroes Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Brother Hollie sets a steady tempo without serious pressure
scenarios.body: The lack of early pace allows the hold-up brigade to get into perfect position before unleashing their finishing kicks in the final half-mile. Those with the best turn of foot and strongest recent form will prove decisive when the race comes alive.

scenarios.label: B

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If Brother Hollie goes too slow and creates a sprint finish
scenarios.body: The race becomes a mad dash from the last hurdle with traffic problems galore as 16 horses try to find racing room. The best jockeys with the handiest positioned horses will navigate through.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Stamina Test Surprise
scenarios.trigger: If the soft ground proves more testing than expected
scenarios.body: The conditions sap the speed horses and turn it into a true staying test where recent winners with proven stamina come to the fore. Those who have won over similar conditions will have a significant edge.

scenarios.title: Late Traffic Problems
scenarios.trigger: If the 15 hold-up horses create a jam in the straight
scenarios.body: The bunched field hits a wall of traffic allowing those with cleaner runs or better positions to prevail. Early positioning becomes crucial with so many runners converging late.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Finish
scenarios.trigger: If Rebel Cowgirl fades and creates a sprint finish
scenarios.body: The leader's stamina gives way on soft ground allowing the strongest finishers to come through. Those with recent form on similar ground gain the edge.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Victory
scenarios.trigger: If Minority Interest or Boola Times get ideal tracking positions
scenarios.body: The prominent runners avoid the traffic problems and have enough left to overhaul a weakening leader. Clean jumping and positioning prove decisive.
